reponse: The root cause was the disks of Kafka broker ingest-kafka-2 filling up after a retention change in infra PR #221 removed size-based retention and left 7-day time-based retention only. The broker went read-only at 09:38 UTC, stalling consumers [2][3]. The outage lasted 2h47m, from 09:38 to 12:25 UTC; events were delayed by up to that amount, with no event loss because producers buffered them [2]. An initial theory blamed PR #388 for increasing insert batch size, but reverting it did not reduce the lag [1][3][5]. Consumer timeouts began at 09:39 UTC and were resolved by 12:24 UTC [4].
